note: A four-view of the T-34/76 of 1941 with the welded turret, the L-11's successor the F-34 and the cast mantlet. Its scale bar reads 154 px/m, and at that scale the width comes out at the published 3.00 m and the top of the periscope on the turret at 2.36 m against a published 2.40. The front view's ground is off the foot of the sheet, so the two end views are pinned on the middle of the hull's roof edge.
